svg.aria-label: Classifieds: Full-stack dev, 4+ yrs, TypeScript end-to-end. Brings own keyboard and strong opinions on state management. Reply within the day. One (1) product team that reviews PRs the same day. Must value shipping over ceremony. Box No. 01. Fast CI pipeline, under ten minutes cold. Flaky stages need not apply. LOST — One (1) semicolon, last seen in a JSON file. Answers to SyntaxError. Reward. FOUND — 3GB of node_modules. Owner must collect by Friday or they will be rm -rf'd without further notice. NOTICE OF DEPRECATION — jQuery is hereby removed from the editor's résumé, effective immediately. Objections in writing. Strong opinions on state management, barely used. Will trade for a code review with teeth. To the flaky E2E test that passed locally and failed in CI three times: I know it was you. We are no longer on speaking terms.
